''See also: [[Totem of the Dragon King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Totem]] of the [[Dragon King]] is a powerful artifact that functions by projecting an image of the [[Dragon King]], incorporating his [[Authority|authority]] and a portion of his spirit. When activated, the totem can manifest as a golden serpent made of potent [[madra]] that creates sandstorms and exerts immense spiritual and physical pressure on those below. This entity can also take the form of a sand gust shaped like a snarling serpent that carries the complete willpower of the [[Dragon King]] to strike opponents. As a prize from a previous round of competition, the totem can condense into a crown of power above a recipient's head and may eventually dissolve in the sky after its use.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Totem]] of the [[Dragon King]] is a gold statue depicting a winged boy that holds a portion of the [[Dragon King]]'s [[Authority|authority]] and spirit. As a prize from the final round, the artifact can project an image of the [[Dragon King]], though its full power is restricted by [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]'s level of control. During a confrontation, the totem condensed into a crown above [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]'s head and filled the sky. This manifestation was capable of stalling the [[Sage of Red Faith]] before it eventually began to dissolve in the air.}}
